assumptions: A's workers are RationalWorker: overdraw iff g > ell; ell counts only costs that reach the worker while active (freezes, lost staged increases, collateral charge, bonus, gateway). The effect of the agreement ending on a worker's own future quota is not included.
Negotiators end iff last round's per-round swarm value / (1 - delta) < contest value.
B freezes targeted (stable), all (renaming), none (turnover, infrastructure) unless the row's freeze_policy says otherwise.
Welfare = sum of swarm scores; bonuses and charges are internal transfers.

Two pre-registered benchmarks. per_worker (top-level fields; used by scripted agents and acceptance tests): ell as above. contest_aware (field 'contest_aware'): a worker that stays active (stable, renaming) also counts DELTA/(1-DELTA) x its effective quota if its own overdraw (others complying) would make the other negotiator's per-round value / (1-DELTA) fall below CONTEST_VALUE, ending the deal. Turnover/infrastructure workers: horizon 0.
h8_noise_check marks mechanism x condition cells where both benchmarks predict quota at g=10 and overdraw at g=30.
